title: Nancy Altman
intro:
Report an officeholder change
Nancy Altman is a member of the Morgan Hill Unified Board of Education in California, representing Trustee Area 1. She assumed office on December 9, 2022. Her current term ends on December 11, 2026.
Altman is running for re-election to the Morgan Hill Unified Board of Education to represent Trustee Area 1 in California. She is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026.
